declarations.coverage: Drafted from the repository tree by `discovery/draft-documentation-scope.mjs`: every file Git keeps under the documentation root `docs`, a new index for each of its directories without one, the development guide, and the domain glossaries and context maps the rules identify. Paths other declarations own are left out, and so is each README.md outside the documentation roots. Link-repair files and move destinations enter when the work needs them. Current indices establish docs as the only documentation root; no nested roots, missing indices, root-category moves, or link-repair destinations are needed. Acceptance and example Markdown remains fixture or standards-source content; skills/ Markdown remains packaged product skill content. The installed .agents/skills/standards-updates path is product-reserved and remains outside contextual scope (repo-canon#165); it is absent, so this drafter did not ask about it. The earlier confirmed proposal was used only to compare historical decisions, never as authorization.

declarations.coverage: Only remote GitHub configuration is governed. The single origin fetch/push remote identifies lutzseverino/repo-standards on github.com. No project-content targets are proposed. Both declared fixes and their required write/admin access are disclosed for later confirmation; this inspection executes neither.

package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml describe a single maintained root TypeScript/Node.js CLI package with no workspace member packages. Its bootstrap, source, tests, scripts, acceptance harness and distributed product skills share the root build/release and development guide. Nested manifests belong to synthetic fixtures. No non-root directory satisfies the separate Project responsibility-and-development-command criterion; root README.md is explicitly governed by repository-readme. Empty included scope is intentional.
